instruction: Please create a compressed zip archive named 'party_poster.zip' containing the party night poster file on Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -f /home/user/Desktop/party_poster.zip ] && unzip -l /home/user/Desktop/party_poster.zip | grep -q 'poster_party_night.webp' && echo 'Archive created.' || echo 'Archive not found.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a zip archive named 'party_poster.zip' containing the poster_party_night.webp file on Desktop. The evaluator checks both that the zip file exists and that it contains the expected file by listing its contents. No custom functions needed - reuses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: zip file existence, correct location (Desktop), correct filename (party_poster.zip), and correct contents (poster_party_night.webp)
Command logic is sound: uses file existence check (-f), unzip -l to list contents, grep -q to verify file presence, and proper success/failure messages
Expected value 'Archive created.\n' correctly matches the success output of the shell command
No state timing issues - zip file persists after creation, no need for postconfig
Edge cases handled: missing file returns 'Archive not found.', corrupted zip would fail unzip command
